items.source_body: W04c explicitly records a change from Euclidean-first to Minkowski-twistor-first foundational viewpoint.
items.guard: Both viewpoints are opaque source labels; no content of either formulation is imported.

items.source_body: W03 records the project chronology as a succession of Euclidean-twistor, right-handed-spacetime, and July-2026 Wick-rotation/chiral-field stages; these are revision relations, not one timeless formulation.
items.guard: Only source chronology and revision classification are represented; stage mathematics is opaque.

items.source_body: W05 presents the Fargues-Fontaine curve at finite primes and the twistor P1 at the infinite prime through an explicit comparison table, while warning that this is an analogy and that the author does not claim mastery of both sides.
items.guard: The compared mathematical objects and finite/infinite-prime roles are raw source labels; the only represented cross-object relation is the source-declared analogy/comparison.

items.source_body: W05 speculates that repeated appearance of the twistor P1 in spacetime physics, Hodge/arithmetic geometry, and quantization may point to a deeper relation, but explicitly allows that it may have no fundamental significance.
items.guard: Occurrence and speculation are represented; no deeper relation is asserted or constructed.

items.source_body: W05 is explicitly expository: its Hodge, arithmetic, quantization, and number-theory discussions are source-semantic contexts for the twistor P1 and must not be promoted to asserted components of the Euclidean Twistor Unification physical model.
items.guard: The non-promotion relation is source-specific extensional scope metadata and is not generalized into a new model-ownership calculus.
